{{Top|leg}}
'''Honest Ellam's Speeder Lot''' was a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] lot, owned by [[Ellam|Honest Ellam]], was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Questal/Legends|Questal]]. Found deep in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Gralleenya]], it was here that Ellam purchased an [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] from [[Bim Maldeen]].
